arguments.cmd:
head -47 model.scad > /tmp/h47.scad; echo 'cube(1);' >> /tmp/h47.scad
openscad /tmp/h47.scad -o /tmp/o47.stl 2>&1 | head -5
echo "=== 48-71 ==="
python3 -c "
h=open('/tmp/h47.scad').read()
open('/tmp/h48.scad','w').write(h)"
sed -n '48,71p' model.scad > /tmp/mid.scad; cat /tmp/mid.scad
echo "=== parse mid alone with stubs ==="
cat > /tmp/stub.scad <<'EOF'
W=80; D=60; Hb=30; Hl=10; T=2.4;
HR=4; BORE_D=4.8; LIPW=20; LIPG=0.3;
$fn=48;
module barrelX(x1,x2,yc,zc,r){ translate([(x1+x2)/2,yc,zc]) rotate([0,90,0]) cylinder(h=x2-x1,r=r,center=true); }
EOF
cat /tmp/stub.scad /tmp/mid.scad > /tmp/midfull.scad; echo 'cube(1);' >> /tmp/midfull.scad
openscad /tmp/midfull.scad -o /tmp/omid.stl 2>&1 | head -5
